                          Weekly Grocery Store Beef Feature Activity
                          Agricultural Marketing Service
                          Livestock, Poultry, & Grain Market News                                                                     Fri Oct 9, 2026
Email us with accessibility issues with this report.
Advertised Prices for Beef Products at Major Grocery Store Outlets ending during the period of 10/3/2026 to 10/15/2026

The information contained in this report reflects prices advertised by major grocery retailers to consumers through
circulars and digital promotions and gathered by USDA through a weekly survey.

MARKET HIGHLIGHTS
This week in beef grocery features, the Feature Rate increased by 7.3% and the Activity Index increased by 9.5%. Compared to last week, items
from the loin, round, ground, and deli sections showed an increase in ad space while items from the brisket, chuck, rib, sirloin, other/misc., and
variety meat sections showed a decrease in ad space.

Explanatory Notes:

FEATURE RATE: the amount of sampled stores advertising any reported item during the current week, expressed as a 'percentage of the total
sample.
ACTIVITY INDEX: a measure of the absolute frequency of feature activity equal to the total number of stores for each advertised item (e.g., a
retailer with 100 outlets featuring 3 items has an activity index of 300).
STORES/AVG: the number of advertising outlets and the weighted average price weighted by the respective number of outlets.
